feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 7:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds for a time later.


##Synopsis##

Weather fronts will move eastwards across the area today.


##Wind##

West or northwest 2 to 4, backing south or southwest 3 or 4 during this morning or early afternoon, then veering and increasing west 4 or 5 in the evening. Possibly touching 6 in the south of area tonight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the west later this morning and afternoon, clearing later in evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing southwest tomorrow morning, decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional showers for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.
